# Weekly Health Tracking Snapshot

**Profile focus:** 34-year-old, mild hypertension, goals of better sleep and lower sodium.
**Week pattern:** better sleep and lower sodium line up with lower blood pressure; higher activity also appears to help.

# Recommended Charts and What They Should Show

| Chart | What it should show | Why it helps |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Sleep vs Blood Pressure trend | Line chart with **SleepHours** and **systolic/diastolic BP** across Mon–Sun | Makes it easy to see whether better sleep lines up with lower readings |
| 2. Sodium Intake vs Blood Pressure | Scatter plot with **SodiumMg** on the x-axis and **BP readings** on the y-axis | Best for spotting whether higher sodium days coincide with higher BP |
| 3. Daily Habits Dashboard | 3-series combo chart for **Steps**, **SleepHours**, and **SodiumMg** by day | Shows the full behavior pattern in one view and highlights good vs difficult days |

# Weekly Log Patterns and Likely Connections

| Day | Sleep (hrs) | Steps | Sodium (mg) | BP |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Mon | 6.2 | 7,200 | 3,100 | 138/88 |
| Tue | 7.1 | 8,400 | 2,500 | 132/84 |
| Wed | 5.8 | 6,100 | 3,400 | 140/90 |
| Thu | 6.9 | 9,000 | 2,200 | 129/82 |
| Fri | 6.4 | 7,800 | 2,900 | 136/86 |
| Sat | 7.8 | 10,500 | 2,100 | 128/80 |
| Sun | 7.0 | 8,800 | 2,400 | 130/83 |

## Concise pattern readout
- **Best BP days** were **Thu, Sat, and Sun**, when sleep was closer to 7+ hours and sodium was lower.
- **Worst BP day** was **Wed**, which also had the **lowest sleep** and **highest sodium**.
- **Steps seem supportive**: the highest-step days, especially **Sat** and **Thu**, also had some of the lowest BP readings.
- The week suggests a **possible inverse relationship** between **sleep quality/quantity** and **blood pressure**.
- The week also suggests a **possible positive relationship** between **sodium intake** and **blood pressure**.
- The data is small, so this is a **trend signal**, not proof of causation.

## Practical interpretation for the charts
- Use **sleep and sodium as the main explanatory variables**.
- Treat **steps as a context variable** that may strengthen the pattern.
- If you want a simple visual rule of thumb, highlight days with:
  - **Sleep ≥ 7.0 hours**
  - **Sodium ≤ 2,400 mg**
  - **Steps ≥ 8,500**
  These days mostly align with better BP in this log.
